adjudication.rationale: In `packages/core/EventManager.ts` `createAllCalendarEvents`, the new multi-destination logic iterates `for (const destination of event.destinationCalendar)` and performs `await createEvent(...)` inside the loop. That makes the external calendar creates run sequentially per destination rather than fanning out concurrently (even the `Promise.all(...)` branch is awaited inside the loop, so destinations are still processed one after another). This is a performance/latency concern for COLLECTIVE events with many hosts, not a correctness defect shown by the diff.
